```{r test-retest-cor}
#| dependson: load-scores

# subset scores to test-retest sample
max_age_gap <- 8/12 # 8 months
retest_scores <- included_mod_scores |>
  filter(site_label == "mpieva-de") |>
  # filter to users with more than one run and small enough age gap between runs
  group_by(user_id, task) |>
  filter(any(run_number > 1)) |>
  filter(all(is.na(age_gap) | age_gap < max_age_gap)) |>
  ungroup()

# widen scores per user to separate columns
retest_wide <- retest_scores |>
  group_by(user_id, task, model_set, subset, itemtype, invariance) |>
  mutate(mean_age = mean(age), 
         mean_age_gap = mean(age_gap, na.rm = TRUE),
         adaptive = if_else(adaptive, "CAT", "fixed"),
         adaptivity = paste(adaptive, collapse = "-")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(task_category, task, item_task,
         model_set, subset, itemtype, nfact, invariance,
         site_label, user_id, mean_age, mean_age_gap, adaptivity,
         run_number, score) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = run_number, values_from = score, names_prefix = "run_")

# subset to core tasks
retest_wide_coretask <- retest_wide |> filter(item_task %in% core_tasks)

# compute test-retest correlations (for all models)
trt_mod <- retest_wide_coretask |>
  group_by(task_category, task, item_task,
           model_set, subset, itemtype, nfact, invariance) |>
  summarise(test_retest_r = cor(run_1, run_2, use = "complete.obs"), 
            n = n(), 
            age_gap_mo = mean(mean_age_gap) * 12) |>
  ungroup()

# subset to specified models per task
trt <- trt_mod |> semi_join(task_mods)

# compare correlations by itemtype
trt_itemtype_compare <- trt_mod |>
  filter(model_set == "multigroup_dataset", invariance == "scalar") |>
  select(task, itemtype, test_retest_r) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = itemtype, values_from = test_retest_r)

# compare correlations by adaptivity
trt_mod_cat <- retest_wide_coretask |>
  group_by(adaptivity, task_category, task, item_task,
           model_set, subset, itemtype, nfact, invariance) |>
  summarise(test_retest_r = cor(run_1, run_2, use = "complete.obs"),
            n = n(), 
            age_gap_mo = mean(mean_age_gap) * 12) |>
  ungroup()
trt_cat <- trt_mod_cat |> semi_join(task_mods) |> arrange(task)
trt_cat_compare <- trt_cat |>
  select(task, subset, adaptivity, test_retest_r) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = adaptivity, values_from = test_retest_r)

trt_task <- trt |> select(item_task, test_retest_r) |> deframe() |> signif(2)
trt_range <- trt_task[!(names(trt_task) %in% c("sds", "math"))] |> range()
```

```{r test-retest-n}
#| dependson: load-scores

# ages for all de participants
de_general_ages <- coretask_scores |>
  filter(site_label == "mpieva-de") |>
  summarise(age = mean(age), .by = c("user_id", "task")) |>
  summarise(age = mean(age), .by = c("user_id"))

de_retest_ages <- retest_wide_coretask |>
  select(user_id, age = mean_age) |>
  distinct()

age_comp <- list("gen" = de_general_ages,
                 "trt" = de_retest_ages) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "sample") |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_age = mean(age),
            sd_age = sd(age),
            .by = "sample") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  nest(d = -sample) |>
  deframe()
```
